title: Updating inside an interval
statement: Let $\mu,\mu'$ be integer-valued sequences and let $a,n,b$ be natural numbers. Suppose they agree at every index less than $a$ or at least $a+n$, and suppose $a\le b<a+n$. For every integer $x$, replacing the value of $\mu'$ at $b$ by $x$ preserves agreement with $\mu$ at every index less than $a$ or at least $a+n$.
hypotheses_covered: Agreement at every index $c<a$ or $a+n\le c$
